title: The Null Crate
summary: A sealed crate with no manifest entry, no sender, and a receipt signed by nobody. Take it to the Glassroad's south gate — a Guild courier relay will meet it there. Handle gently. Nobody will say why.

objectives.label: Collect the unsigned crate at the Guild exchange
Deliver it to the relay at the Glassroad south gate

offer.text: This crate showed up in the exchange overnight. No manifest line, no sender wax, weight listed as 'approximately regret'. The Guild pays triple for things it can't file.

accept.text: Gently, courier. I measured it for the ledger and it measured *back*. I'm choosing to find that charming.
It's humming. Crates don't hum. I'm putting that in my report.
Radio check, kid: if a crate hums, you hum louder. Assert dominance. Old courier trick that has never once helped.

complete.text: Relay's a no-show. Gate's empty. But the crate… it stopped humming when I set it down. Like it arrived.
Logged as delivered. Varga — off the record — your name got entered into a ledger at the exchange tonight. By a hand that wasn't there. Get some sleep.
